## Verification

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:install`
- [ ] `npm run test:self-host` (Registry, migration, RLS, or Docker changes)
- [ ] `npm run audit:prod`
- [ ] Changed production sources pass `pitlore check`
- [ ] No secrets, PII, private Lessons, evidence, customer names, or internal hosts
- [ ] Unverified external or production boundaries are stated explicitly
